content_html_sanitized:
The excellent British website, TalkingDrugs.org  is published by Release, a long established think tank and drug policy reform advocate. They have the rather thankless task of trying to bring common sense to British drugs policies, where the usual discourse is just to run around screaming, “Skunk”!!!!


Also See Amsterdam and London: A Tale of Two Cities


They have just published a really disturbing report on the wretched state of the cannabis situation in Hungary.

 See Hungary’s New Drug Policy: Zero-Tolerance and Hate Campaigns


The Hungarian president, Victor Orban, has undermined Hungarian democracy and relishes being Putin’s puppet in the EU.

See Viktor Orbán visits Vladimir Putin to condemnation from fellow EU leaders. Brussels disassociates itself from Hungarian PM’s Moscow trip, which he has tried to cast as a peace mission


Sadly, even liberal democracies like France have really wretched cannabis policies.

See France Making An Even Bigger Mess of Its Cannabis Policy, But Finally About to Legalize Medical After Only Thirty Years


However, the Hungarian regime has tied itself so closely to Putin and Russian cannabis policies are so absurd that they should embarrass European Prohibitionists.

 “Alcohol encouraged, cannabis demonised.

Alongside announcing a zero-tolerance policy against drug dealers, the government launched a “pub program, ” under which pubs in towns with fewer than 1,000 residents can apply for a fund of 7,500 euros to use for any purpose, “because pubs are the primary community spaces in small villages. “

When asked about the support for alcohol in the fight against drugs, the Minister for the Prime Minister’s Office stated: “The key distinction is that using drugs is illegal, while drinking alcohol is not, and in moderation, alcohol can have health benefits.“

The blatant hypocrisy does not seem to be understood in a country where, according to WHO figures, almost one in five Hungarians are considered problematic drinkers. While the government promotes alcohol, it continues to block access to medical cannabis, persecuting those accessing it illegally.”

This extreme cruelty may shock Europeans, but not the Heritage Foundation, the “conservative” American corporate think tank. See Hungary Leads Way in Defense of Conservative Values.

On the contrary, Heritage has a long history of Prohibitionist propaganda.

So you can know: From Heritage See Twenty-First Century Illicit Drugs and Their Discontents: The Troubling Potency of Twenty-First Century Cannabis December 7, 2022 

See The Perils of Potent Pot Party Line: Blaming Marijuana Legalization for Increase in THC Levels

And from 2000 in the MarijuanaNews archives:

The Heritage Foundation Uses The Florida Drug Czar To Lie To Conservatives About Medical Marijuana. Very Badly.

I will be reporting more about The Heritage Foundation’s astonishing dishonesty soon.
